title: Q-RES-chen-stratton-2026-F7: One approver is a single point of failure (measured 0, target >= 1)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: chen-stratton-2026 finding F7 is not-met (measured 0)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe chen-stratton-2026:F7
**Prediction:** self_deploys >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Concern: One approver is a single point of failure. The study: Reviewers mostly review code they already know (82.8% versus 17.2% at random); an interviewee describes one senior engineer as the only approver, reviewing once a week.

Mechanisms that should answer it: GUIDING-DIRECTIVE section 12 (doctrine/registers.json); NO-SINGLE-ROUTE (foundation/failover.py).

Metric: verified deploys the system originated and executed itself (latest criticality tick), target >= 1. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 8.4 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T05:40:48Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: chen-stratton-2026:F7: self_deploys = 31 target >= 1 (met)
